notice:
A component index derived from [KanjiVG](https://kanjivg.tagaini.net) r20260714 (commit d95a976): for each kanji, the elements its stroke-order drawing is built from, at every depth, with part stroke counts taken from the KanjiVG drawings. The elements are graphical, not etymological.
